observations: Photo shows a bare engine block without the vehicle attached, sitting on a dirty workshop floor.
Visible parts: alternator, serpentine belt, wiring harness, valve cover with pink sealant residue, intake manifold area.
No manufacturer nameplate, engine code, or model sticker is legible anywhere in the frame.
A watermark reading 'CAMON 40' with camera settings (23mm f/1.8 1/50s ISO506) appears at the bottom — this is a phone-camera watermark, not a vehicle or engine identifier.
No fitment info (which car make/model this engine fits) is visible in the photo.

identity.kind: used (Tokunbo) petrol car engine, bare long block with accessories

claims.evidence: No import documentation, customs sticker, or Japan auction sheet visible in the photo; origin cannot be confirmed from an image of a bare engine.
No test rig, compression gauge, running video, or diagnostic readout shown; engine appears static and disconnected.
A warranty is a seller policy, not something a photo can confirm; no written warranty card or receipt shown.

risks.risk: Exact vehicle make/model/engine code this fits is unknown, which drives price heavily.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the engine code stamp/plate (usually on block near gearbox mount) or a shot of the chassis/engine number tag.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unidentified generic used engine at the low end of the category

risks.risk: Engine may not run or may have internal faults (compression, timing, knocking).
risks.proof: Video of the engine running/idling with sound, plus a compression test reading.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not confirmed working (worst case: non-running)

risks.risk: Engine could be incomplete (missing sensors, wiring loom, turbo, ECU) compared to a full swap-ready unit.
risks.proof: Additional photos from front, rear, and both sides showing full wiring harness and all bolt-on accessories.

risks.risk: Mileage and true usage history are unknown.
risks.proof: Japan auction sheet or odometer photo if available.

risks.risk: Fluid leaks (oil, coolant) not visible from this single angle.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the oil pan, valve cover gasket, and underside for leak stains.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the engine code/model stamp or ID plate on the block.
Video of the engine running with audible sound, ideally cold start.
Photos from all four sides showing full wiring harness, sensors, and accessories.
Any Japan export/auction sheet or import documentation for provenance.
Close-up of oil pan and gasket areas for leak evidence.
response.reason: The engine's make/model cannot be read from the single photo, and without that the applicable price bracket for 'used engine' comparables cannot be set even at worst case; a legible engine code or model shot is needed first.
